tools.name: get_account_state
tools.description: Return the authorized advertising account, workspace, connection, Signal destination, and currently available read-only capabilities.

tools.name: get_signal_health
tools.description: Diagnostic view of first-party event flow, Meta delivery outcomes, match quality, and reconciliation gaps from PlainRouter stored measurements. Not admissible evidence for spend-affecting proposals. Does not call the Marketing API.

tools.name: get_performance
tools.description: Admissible proposal evidence comparing Meta-reported conversions with gateway-verified accepted conversions from stored daily reconciliation reports.

tools.name: verify_signal_ingestion
tools.description: Verify end-to-end server-side Signal ingestion for onboarding activation. Writes one idempotent, identity-free verification event for the authorized workspace Signal and confirms ledger receipt. No spend capability.

tools.name: propose-actions
tools.description: Propose a batch of budget, status, upload, or creative-duplication actions for the approved ad account. Every proposal passes the workspace policy gate; suggest-only approval never executes it.

tools.name: get-creative-library
tools.description: Return Meta image and video assets with the ads and last-30-day performance historically associated with each asset.

tools.name: upload-asset
tools.description: Stage a JPEG/PNG image and submit a canonical upload action through the policy and approval gate.

tools.name: duplicate-ad-with-creative
tools.description: Submit a canonical proposal to duplicate a source Meta ad with a different creative asset. Approved copies are always created PAUSED.

tools.name: launcher.draft_batch
tools.description: Create a Launch draft batch from already-synced Drive assets in the workspace and ad account bound to the execution token.

tools.name: launcher.batch_status
tools.description: Read the bounded status projection of one Launch batch in the workspace and ad account bound to the execution token.

tools.name: launcher.preview_batch
tools.description: Run the authoritative Launch gate preview checkpoint over one batch in the workspace and ad account bound to the execution token.

tools.name: launcher.execute_batch
tools.description: Enter execution for one Launch batch in the workspace and ad account bound to the execution token; every mutation is proposed through Actions.

tools.name: show_spend_cap_approval
tools.description: Render the static spend-cap approval preview card. Reads and writes nothing.
